note: Data extracted by the plant reader; read-only sources; no simulation run. Rates and costs are runs x measured rate (V475), mix average, not measured per cell.

slowdown.params: edge (default 4), limit_kmh, dur, times[], taper (s, linear down, abrupt end)
slowdown.affects: every vehicle on the edge (edge maxSpeed; vehicles apply speedFactor)
slowdown.intended_use: kind named in V&V s1 but only X1/X2 instances; other draws labelled outside (V462(4))
slowdown.in_training: single event, edges 3/4/5, 25-60 km/h, 60-180 s, start 400-1200 s, taper 20

random.params: seed+910000: p=1/3 none, else slowdown edge U{3,4,5}, U(25,60) km/h, U(60,180) s, U(400,1200) s, taper 20

brake.params: period, first (default warm), target_kmh or factor, hold; decel 4 m/s2; edge 4 lane 1, 500+-200 m
brake.affects: one human car (not ALKS, not trailer) per period
brake.r1m3_effect: V342: 0 m wave reach, delay within 2 %

truck.params: period, first, cap_kmh; first trailer on edge 1 within 600 m; capped for its whole trip

burst.params: cycle; ramp departures >= warm moved to ceil(t/cycle)*cycle, both ramps, same grid
burst.affects: all ramp vehicles (timing only, volume unchanged)

outage.affects: every ALKS: V2V gate off, tau back to 1.6 s (rise <= 0.2 s/s)
outage.intended_use: outside, explicitly excluded (V&V s1 'Not for V2V with latency or loss'; PR-16)

3E-X1.pick: g003i02 (generation 3) loss -32.60, delay -1.05 %; the 3 better shortlisted configs had delay 2.38-2.64 % on 40 seeds and were not admissible
